label: early input/delimiter step shortly after w, u, 2 or d
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase and on the <DEL> step (84% / 16% of mass; almost never in the copy phase), at steps 1-5, when one of the tokens w, u, 2 or d was input one or two steps earlier. Activation is largest right after the trigger token (prev_tok lift about 4-5x, w strongest, then u, 2, d) and is weaker two steps later. It is larger at earlier positions and when the trigger repeats: the top activations are w w <DEL> or m w w <DEL> at about 1.0 of max. Weaker firing follows k, t and m. It does not fire at t=0 or in the copy phase, and rarely past step 6 even when a trigger was just seen. Low-quartile activations (about 0.1 of max) are scattered on early steps with no trigger, which the predicate misses. Dev F1 0.73, mass recall 0.83.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: w, u, 2, d, k, t; least: j, 1, -, f) and the input two steps back (most: w, u, d, 2, k, t; least: y, 1, f, j); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, t=2, L=3 & t=4.
